title: OpenAI’s AI spending spree has ballooned to $750B
slides: What happens when $750 billion isn't enough?
Most of that goes to chips and data centers.
But OpenAI's revenue still can't cover the costs.
Your next API price hike may already be planned.
Ask your cloud provider what their break-even is.
thread_text:
1. What if $750B isn’t enough?

Sam Altman just asked for $7 trillion. That’s 10x the current ask.

2. Chips eat the budget first.

Nvidia’s H100s cost $30,000 each. A single data center burns billions before a model trains.

3. Revenue trails spending.

OpenAI’s annualized revenue is $3.4B. Costs run higher every quarter.

4. Users will pay the gap.

API prices already doubled in 2024. Another increase is being tested internally.

5. Ask your cloud provider their break-even.

Call AWS or Azure sales today. If they dodge, you know the next bill is coming.
video_script: Altman asked for seven trillion dollars.
Revenue is three point four billion.
